market.question: Bitcoin Up or Down on May 9?

Now May 9 morning, BTC is at ~$80,369 with a 24h range of $79,149-$80,450 and +1.25% (Phemex). To resolve Up, BTC at noon ET May 9 simply needs to close above the May 8 noon ET print; current price is meaningfully above it, modest tilt to Up. Weekend trading is thin so range moves can be quick.
